Marking as -2 so these do not get merged as the rest of the stack is reviewed.

The project policy is that all project-maintained recipes point to project-maintained repositories (i.e. repositories under the openbmc github org).

I won't accept forks of Linux here. The work should be integrated upstream, and then backported to openbmc/linux.

This is a temporary solution until OpenBMC Linux officially supports AST2700.
It is used for verifying patch https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/openbmc/+/73642.

For now, my main objective is to get patch 73642 accepted.
The Linux support added in this commit is just for testing.
